title: How Citizens Bank reimagined CX with Amazon Connect Customer & GenAI
abstract: Citizens Financial Group is transforming its customer service ecosystem using Amazon Connect Customer, Amazon Lex, and generative AI. In this session, learn how Citizens migrated legacy IVR and contact center infrastructure to Amazon Connect Customer, deployed conversational AI across voice and digital channels, and integrated generative AI-powered agent assist and real-time conversation intelligence. We cover the solution architecture spanning Amazon Connect Customer, Amazon Lex, Amazon Bedrock, AWS Lambda, and Amazon EventBridge, along with measurable outcomes in containment rates, handle time, and routing accuracy. Attendees will gain a practical blueprint for enterprise-scale customer experience transformation in financial services.
room: Upper Convention Promenade, Cristal 2, Content Hub, Purple Theater
speakers: James Kraeutler (Principal Product Manager, AWS)
Deepak Nair (SVP - Operations & Contact Center Transformation, Citizens Bank)

title: How Ramp tracks and governs AI spend down to the team, model, and API key
abstract: When AI token spend spans multiple providers and dozens of teams, knowing who spent what, on which model, and whether it's COGS or OpEx requires its own pipeline. We'll cover ingesting usage data from third-party AI APIs, processing with Temporal workers, persisting on Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, running on Amazon ECS Fargate, and surfacing anomalies before they hit your invoice. See how Ramp attributes spend by provider, model, team, and API key, and attributes cost down to the request-level when teams connect their router, gateway, or internal data. Learn how Ramp separates COGS from OpEx for accurate unit economics, then closes the loop with governance.
room: Upper Convention Promenade, Cristal 2, Content Hub, Purple Theater
speakers: Alexander Chau (Software Engineer, Ramp)
Jigna Gandhi (Sr. Solutions Architect, Amazon)
Richard Wang (Staff Software Engineer, Ramp)
Siddhi Surana (Product Manager, Ramp)

title: Unified Commerce Intelligence for Amazon Brands on Amazon Quick
abstract: Brands selling on Amazon generate rich signals across commerce and advertising — order trends, catalog performance, competitive pricing, campaign metrics, and customer engagement. The opportunity lies in connecting these signals into a unified view that drives faster, smarter decisions. In this chalk talk, we design an architecture that composes two Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers — the SP-API MCP Server for Selling Partner operations and the Amazon Ads MCP Server for campaigns and reporting — behind Amazon Quick as a conversational layer. We'll whiteboard how brands can build cross-domain queries, like correlating ad spend with order velocity or surfacing catalog insights that inform campaign strategy. Leave with production-grade patterns for building agentic commerce workflows tailored to your brand's data
speakers: Duncan Watson (Solution Architect, AWS)
Manikanta Gona Grafsgaard (Sr Solutions Architect, AWS)

title: Rise of Autonomous Clinical Data Management: AI Agents Accelerating Drug Development (sponsored by Cognizant)
abstract: Explore how autonomous AI agents are transforming clinical data management from a collection of manual processes into an intelligent, continuously learning system that improves quality, accelerates study execution, and shortens the path from protocol to patient impact. Clinical trials generate unprecedented volumes of complex data, yet many Clinical Data Management (CDM) processes remain highly manual, resource-intensive, and constrained by siloed workflows. Critical activities such as protocol interpretation, clinical trial data systems build and configuration, edit check generation, data review, data quality management, reconciliation, and database lock often reside on the critical path to study completion. This presentation is brought to you by Cognizant, an AWS Partner.
room: Level 1, Forum 120, Content Hub, Blue Theater
speakers: Nareen Katta (Sr. Director, Strategy & Operations, AbbVie)
Gaurav Sharma (Market Innovator, Cognizant)

title: Beyond Search: How Gilead Built a Multi-Agent AI That Reasons Like a Scientist (sponsored by Thoughtworks)
abstract: Gilead is pivoting from virology leader to oncology and immunology powerhouse, targeting 10+ transformative therapies by 2030. With Thoughtworks, Gilead built an AI co-scientist on AWS that reasons across 1M+ ELN assay records, 3M+ internal documents and external literature. It reads assay, compound and target data like a scientist, returning one cited answer with conflicts flagged. Scientists now reach evidence-backed decisions in minutes, not days. Gilead and Thoughtworks share how the solution earned scientists' trust. This presentation is brought to you by Thoughtworks, an AWS Partner.
room: Level 2, Hall B, Expo, Industry Theater
speakers: Shayan Mohanty (Chief Data & AI Officer, Thoughtworks)

title: Don't rewrite your APIs: Make them agent-ready for agentic AI
abstract: Organizations want agentic AI, but valuable capabilities sit behind legacy APIs, AWS Lambda functions, and internal services. In this chalk talk, we explore practical, low-lift patterns for making existing endpoints agent-ready without replacing systems of record. Using a financial services scenario, we walk through how OpenAPI specs, AWS Lambda facades, and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway expose existing endpoints as composable agent tools. We show how existing RBAC and OAuth scopes map into Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Cedar policies so you reuse your governance posture. Walk away with a 5-level maturity model you can apply to your own API estate.
speakers: Piyali Kamra (Sr Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)
Amit Maindola (Senior Data & AI Architect, Amazon Web Services)

title: Optimizing agentic AI: Vanguard's production deployment journey
abstract: Deploying AI agents in production is just the beginning. Optimizing them at scale is the real challenge. In this session, Vanguard shares how they transformed their investor-facing AI agent from functional to fast, safe, and personal. Learn the techniques—from prompt caching to adaptive thinking to guardrail tuning—that delivered 70%+ latency reduction without sacrificing safety, and how long-term memory now powers personalized conversations across sessions. Walk away with battle-tested patterns for balancing response quality, cost, and speed in agentic AI at enterprise scale.
room: Upper Convention Promenade, Cristal 2, Content Hub, Red Theater
speakers: Krishna Gogineni (Principal Solutions Architect, Amazon)
Jay Wolfe (Chief AI Architect, The Vanguard Group)
Ritesh Shah (CHIEF ARCHITECT - AI/ML, The Vanguard Group)

title: How Santander governs hundreds of AI agents in production on Amazon Bedrock
abstract: Financial institutions need a consistent way for independent teams to build, deploy, and govern AI agents without creating silos or losing visibility. In this session, learn how Banco Santander built Santander Cortex—a self-service platform where business teams configure, deploy, and monitor their own AI agents with tools, knowledge bases, memory, guardrails, and authorization using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. We'll cover identity integration, agent-to-agent (A2A) interoperability across independently owned teams, and the governance model that made self-service possible without losing control. The platform runs hundreds of agents, including customer-facing chatbots serving millions of users across more than 10 countries.
room: Upper Convention Promenade, Cristal 2, Content Hub, Red Theater
speakers: Javier Ros (SVP, Global Head of AI Engineer, Banco Santander HQ)
Juan Antonio Albarrán Fernández (GFS Senior Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)
Hector Rodes (Applied AI Engineering Director, Banco Santander)

title: Danske Bank's AI City: Scaling AI agents across an enterprise
abstract: Getting AI agents into production across a regulated enterprise means solving governance and security first. Danske Bank started with a handful of generative AI experiments and now runs more than 40 use cases in production. In this session, learn how Danske Bank built "AI City"—a governed, reusable platform that cut time-to-production from months to days. See how they structured the platform so new teams can ship agents without rebuilding authorization, logging, or model access controls from scratch, with production examples from personal banking, compliance, and capital markets, and explore the Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore architecture underneath it all.
room: Upper Convention Promenade, Cristal 2, Content Hub, White Theater
speakers: Anantharaman Seshadri (Senior Solutions Architect, AWS)
Kasper Tjørntved Davidsen (Chief GenAI Officer, Danske Bank A/S)
John Bustamante Madsen (Senior Vice President, Danske Bank)

title: Core banking agent-ready: From composable to agentic financial services on AWS
abstract: The shift from composable to agentic banking is a re-architecture. Discover the reference architecture for turning a core banking platform into an intelligent core with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore for orchestration, Amazon ECS for the control plane, Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases for domain context, and Amazon EventBridge for event-driven ingestion. We explore two consumption patterns ISVs can offer bank customers: exposing core banking APIs to customer-owned agents, and shipping a managed agentic layer for conversational AI and autonomous lending, deposit, and payment operations, eliminating up to 70% of repetitive manual work. Learn the hard-won lessons on infrastructure, governance, and product differentiation.
speakers: Neha Daudani (Senior Solutions Architect, AWS)
Michelle Mei-Li Pfister (Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)

title: AI discipline: UCLA's data foundation and framework for saying no
abstract: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) invested in their data foundation first. Their large-scale data modernization—Bruin Cloud and the campus Data Hub—created a unified, governed data environment across a sprawling research university, but it wasn't enough. As AI demand surged, Deputy CIO Veronica Garcia and her team built a disciplined product management approach to evaluate, prioritize, and scale AI use cases against UCLA's mission. Learn how UCLA’s technical architecture accelerated data modernization, the framework used to determine AI priorities, and the governance model that keeps it all aligned that launched high-impact use cases from increasing fundraising, advancing research, and supporting student safety and success.
room: Upper Convention Promenade, Cristal 2, Content Hub, Purple Theater
speakers: Mary Strain (Business Development AI and Machine Learning, US EDU, Amazon Web Services)
Aditya Singh (AIML Specialist Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services Inc.)

title: Tackling a $30M fraud crisis with ML: California Community Colleges
abstract: The California Community Colleges, the largest higher education system in the U.S. serving 1 in 4 community college students nationally. Since 2024, it has faced a fraud crisis targeting over $30M, as stolen-identity breaches and generative AI made ghost-student attempts cheaper and harder to catch. Machine learning (ML) on Amazon SageMaker now screens applicants centrally, driving a 64% decrease in attempted fraud year over year. Campus-level detection tools add a second layer, catching 2x more fraudulent applications than human review alone. This session covers the ML architecture, how it integrates across 116 campuses, and how reclaimed seats and aid dollars directly improved access for legitimate students.
room: Upper Convention Promenade, Cristal 2, Content Hub, White Theater
speakers: Julia Arreguy (Chief Technology Officer, California Community Colleges Technology Center)
Mitul Ganger (Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)

title: Ontology-Powered AI Agents: Verifiable Decisions Across Manufacturing
abstract: Manufacturing stakeholders make dozens of high-velocity decisions daily. Each must be traceable, defensible, and grounded in enterprise knowledge and lifecycle data. Yet the systems informing these decisions remain siloed, and AI agents reasoning over this fragmented data cannot produce verifiable results. Ontologies solve this by structuring manufacturing knowledge so agents can trace decisions back to their source data. In this chalk talk, we show how ontology-grounded agents, powered by Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and Strands Agents SDK, make verifiable decisions across the lifecycle with a live demo. Attendees leave with a reference architecture, best practices, and a clear path to building verifiable AI agents for manufacturing.
speakers: Raja GT (WW Senior Solutions Architect, Manufacturing, Amazon Web Services)
Vedanth Srinivasan (Head of Solutions, Engineering & Design, Amazon Web Services)

title: Autonomous Multi-Agent system for Manufacturing: Live Demo with Kiro
abstract: To achieve the operational agility markets require, manufacturers are turning to AI agents that can reason and act autonomously across the product lifecycle. This session demonstrates how to rapidly build autonomous multi-agent systems using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and Kiro that connect CMMS, MES, and ERP systems through Model Context Protocol (MCP). Watch a live demo where we use Kiro to develop specialized manufacturing agents that detect anomalies, diagnose root causes, and orchestrate corrective actions autonomously. Discover how Kiro's spec-driven development workflow compresses multi-agent system development from months to days. Leave with proven architecture patterns that you can apply to transform your production planning, supply chain optimization, and anomaly management processes.
speakers: Christophe Renard (Sr Partner Solution Architect, AWS)
Mourad Alia (Sr Partner Physical AI Solution Architect, AWS)

speakers: Christophe Renard (Sr Partner Solution Architect, AWS)
Mourad Alia (Sr Partner Physical AI Solution Architect, AWS)

title: How FINRA Brings Governed Agentic AI to Its Member Firms on AWS
abstract: FINRA protects investors and enforces regulation for 3,400+ broker-dealer firms and 1.2 million financial professionals, so regulation must evolve as fast as the markets it oversees. FINRA is exploring the role agentic AI services like Amazon Quick can play on FINRA’s Gateway, its primary external platform serving firms. This session covers the how: the design patterns and guardrails for responsible AI in a regulated environment, including draft-and-attest human accountability, data grounding with hallucination detection, tenant isolation, and a pragmatic governance model. Behind that experience, FINRA keeps models and frameworks interchangeable, so capabilities evolve without rebuilding. Leave with a practical framework for governing agentic AI at scale.
room: Upper Convention Promenade, Cristal 2, Content Hub, White Theater
speakers: Noah Egorin (Vice President, Product Management, FINRA)
Eric Weller (SVP Technology, FINRA - Financial Industry Regulatory Authority)
Brandon Webb (Senior Solutions Architect, Amazon)

title: Unifying fragmented data: A lakehouse for the agentic AI era
abstract: Financial services organizations face growing data volumes, strict regulations, and architectures where siloed warehouses and separate data lakes fragment data, drive up costs, and slow insights. In this chalk talk, we walk through a modern Lakehouse architecture on AWS that combines the cost benefits of data lakes with the governance and performance of data warehouses. We explain how Amazon S3 Tables with managed Apache Iceberg and AWS Glue Catalog semantic search deliver a single governed data foundation supporting agentic AI, traditional AI/ML, and analytics workloads. Learn practical patterns for a scalable Lakehouse you can apply immediately.
speakers: Prasad Shetty (Sr Solutions Architect, AWS)
Himanshu Sahni (Senior Data & AI Architect, AWS)

title: From Hours to Minutes: Fast Android Builds and Virtual Testing on AWS
abstract: Automotive software teams lose hours to a slow development cycle: Android builds run for hours, and testing means waiting on scarce physical target hardware. This chalk talk shows how to compress that cycle on AWS. SourceFS cuts Android build times from ~3 hours to under 5 minutes, and the Virtual Engineering Workbench (VEW) lets engineers test against virtual targets in the cloud instead of queuing for physical boards. We'll build up the reference architecture live, show where each piece fits, and walk through the adoption path customers are on today.
speakers: Hendrik Schoeneberg (Principal Consultant, Data, Amazon Web Services)
Raphael Hofer (Industry Specialist Regulatory Compliance Automotive, Amazon Web Services)

title: Tekion: Reinventing automotive retail with agentic AI on AWS
abstract: Automotive retail runs on complex, menu-driven workflows — scheduling service, ordering parts, structuring deals, closing books. Tekion, whose cloud-native platform powers thousands of dealerships, reimagined it as conversational AI, the industry's first AI-native automotive DMS. Built on Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and Amazon Bedrock Guardrails, Tekion's production agents — spanning sales, service, parts, F&I, and accounting — execute actions rather than suggesting them, serving every role from service advisor to dealer principal. Learn how Tekion architected a reusable agent platform, applied guardrails for safe autonomy, and turned industry operations AI-native.
speakers: Vibhu Pareek (Senior Solutions Architect, AWS India)

title: Closing the academic advising gap with AI agents
abstract: Universities lose students to inadequate academic advising: advisors are overwhelmed, and students wait days for answers. In this chalk talk, we explore the end-to-end architecture of an AI student advising agent: specifying and building the agents with Kiro on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, connecting it to student record systems via MCP, adding guardrails for sensitive student welfare queries, and surfacing the agents to students through AWS Quick embedded in their existing LMS. We'll whiteboard real-world advising scenarios, turn them into agents you can evaluate, and discuss the trade-offs between automation and human escalation.
speakers: Maria John (Senior Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)
Nityanand Singh (Sr. AI/ML SA, Amazon Web Services)

title: How Bridgewater Associates uses agentic SDLC to accelerate change
abstract: Learn how Bridgewater Associates, a leading macroeconomic investment manager, built an agentic SDLC platform that transformed the way technology and investment teams work by leveraging AI agents to automate the software development lifecycle. Built as an AI teammate in Slack and powered by an orchestration service running these agents in secure sandboxes, the platform automates every stage of the SDLC—from idea inception through merge requests in GitLab to deploying code that generates investment signals. Amazon Bedrock powers their coding agents, orchestration stages, and custom agents built using agent SDKs. This session will also discuss integration with AWS frontier agents like AWS DevOps Agent.
speakers: Sayan Chakraborty (Senior Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)
Henry Olschofka (Head of Agentic Engineering, Bridgewater Associates)
Peter Sideris (Principal Technical Account Manager, Amazon Web Services)
Jason Kowalewski (Tech Lead, Bridgewater Associates)

title: Northwestern Mutual: Reinventing policy servicing with agentic AI
abstract: Financial representatives at Northwestern Mutual traditionally logged service requests and waited for back-office resolution. In this session, we'll walk through the production architecture behind this transformation: Amazon Bedrock Agents connected to core insurance systems through the Model Context Protocol, with orchestration and governance controls designed for a regulated environment. We'll cover authorization patterns, auditability, human oversight, and lessons learned moving from proof of concept to production. Representatives now resolve significantly more requests directly—reducing resolution times, improving good-order processing, and driving higher satisfaction, with participants reporting better outcomes for their clients.
room: Upper Convention Promenade, Cristal 2, Content Hub, Red Theater
speakers: Brett Truelove (Sr Director Data Software Engineering, The Northwestern Mutual Life Insurance Company)
Kristopher Pfeiffer (Senior Director, AI Solutions Engineering, The Northwestern Mutual Life Insurance Company)
Andy Hall (Sr. Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)

title: How Paytm powers millions of customer journeys with AI agents on AWS
abstract: Every Paytm customer and merchant leaves a trail—payments, transfers, loans, logins, chats, and voice conversations. Together, these events form a story. Pi Agents, Paytm's multimodal agentic platform on AWS, turns that story into action across acquisition, retention, monetization, and support for 50M+ merchants and 80M+ monthly users. A Paytm-built foundation model learns from 100B+ activity sequences, while specialized SLMs and voice models enable sub-second interactions across 10+ languages. Beyond the customer lifecycle, Pi Agents powers sales, marketing, support, and operations. This session explores how Paytm combines these models with agents to understand, decide, and act.
room: Upper Convention Promenade, Cristal 2, Content Hub, White Theater
speakers: Punit Jain (Principal Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)
Tanmoy Bhowmik (Vice President, Paytm Mobile Solutions Pvt. Ltd.)

title: Allianz: Building domain AI agents that scale across the enterprise
abstract: Delivering one coherent agent experience across a large enterprise means connecting agents to core business systems, each with its own identity, compliance, and security requirements. Learn how Allianz moved a reusable agentic framework into regulated production, with one entry point routing every request to specialist domain agents through open standards like MCP. The session covers the trust model, with scoped authorization at every boundary, and how shared services for identity, data protection, and consent let business teams focus on their domain. Finally, discover go-live lessons and who owns a shared agent service across legal entities.
room: Upper Convention Promenade, Cristal 2, Content Hub, White Theater
speakers: Lars Nettemann (Head of AI Use Case Delivery, Allianz)
Patrik Nagel (Principal Solutions Architect, AWS)
Lennard Ufer (Product Owner Data Platform, Allianz)

title: Talk to your market data: Agentic AI meets exchange feeds
abstract: In this builders’ session, connect an Amazon Bedrock agent layer to a high-performance data pipeline that turns 560M IEX exchange messages into an interactive playground. Analysts describe trading ideas in natural language (no SQL or Python required) while the agent queries Parquet data, generates strategy logic, runs backtests, and returns results. Dig into the C++ parsing, serverless orchestration with AWS Batch and AWS Fargate, Amazon S3, and guardrail patterns that make it production ready. Leave with architecture patterns, a cost model, and a blueprint for adding an agentic layer that takes anyone from market intuition to tested strategy in minutes.
speakers: Santhosh Sampath (Cloud Architect III, AWS)
Ravindra Kori (Senior Solutions Architect, Amazon)
Sribalaji Thirunavukkarasu (Cloud Architect, AWS)
Alket Memushaj (Sr. Mgr - Regulated Industries - Startups, AWS)

title: State Street: AI agents that write, deploy, and govern at scale
abstract: Landing zones, drift detection, and migration backlogs pile up faster than platform teams can manage. In this lightning talk, State Street will share how they built AI agents that embed directly in application teams, taking infrastructure requirements as input, generating compliant Terraform, and handling provisioning without a ticket queue. Every resource stays within policy guardrails before it reaches production. Learn how integrating AI agents into the DevOps lifecycle accelerates delivery while maintaining governance and security across the enterprise.
room: Level 2, Hall B, Expo, Industry Theater
speakers: Ata Turk (Head of AWS Platforms, State Street)
Vignesh Ashok kumar (Vice President, State Street Corp)
Manjit Chakraborty (Senior Solution Architect, Amazon Web Services)

title: How Nordstrom, Coca-Cola Andina & Mondelez use agentic supply chains
abstract: Supply chain leaders are moving from dashboards that report problems to agents that resolve them, sensing disruption, optimizing routing, and acting in real time. Hear how three retail and CPG leaders deployed agentic AI on AWS at scale. Nordstrom built a multi-agent framework on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, starting with an agent that cut audit investigations from five weeks to thirty seconds. Coca-Cola Andina developed Miruta, a multi-agent routing solution optimizing supply chain operations across its bottling network. And Mondelez is modernizing production and distribution across 150+ countries. Each shares their architecture, what changed for their teams, and measurable results.
room: Level 1, Forum 120, Content Hub, Orange Theater
speakers: Fernando Jana Vergara (Chief Strategy and Digital Officer, Coca-Cola Andina)
Pawan Kushwaha (Sr Engineering Manager, Nordstrom)

title: Tapestry, Grupo Boticario & Nestle Purina on agentic commerce
abstract: AI agents are changing how consumers discover and buy, splitting into two investments: retailers building conversational shopping on their own properties, and consumer goods companies optimizing how their products surface when agents shop on a consumer's behalf. In this session, hear how Tapestry built the Kate Spade AI Gift Concierge that turns luxury gifting into a guided conversation; Grupo Boticario launched an agentic Virtual Assistant orchestrating product discovery and checkout for millions of users; and Nestle Purina implemented an Answer Engine Optimization strategy, using their native chatbot Allie to pressure-test how external AI engines surface proprietary brand data before releasing it into circulation.
room: Level 1, Forum 120, Content Hub, Blue Theater
speakers: Mandeep Bhatia (SVP, Global digital product and innovation, Tapestry, Inc)
Ann Scharenberg (Director of Marketing Technology, Nestlé S.A.)
Todd Carter (Head of Solution Architecture - Retail, Restaurant and CPG, AWS)
Isabel Miranda (Executive Director of Technology, Grupo Boticário)

title: Warehouse Alchemy: How Eni's AI agents cut days of sourcing to minutes
abstract: Eni operates one of the world's most complex upstream supply chains, managing exploration and production materials across warehouses on multiple continents. Tubular items alone represent €1.5 billion out of a €2.5 billion inventory — scattered across dozens of facilities with fragmented visibility. Engineers searching for available spare parts faced a manual, days-long process of cross-referencing spreadsheets, navigating import restrictions, certifications, third-party stock, and delivery schedules — often resulting in unnecessary new purchases while surplus materials sat idle in distant warehouses. With Eni's expansion into fast-track development, biofuel production, and CCUS, the traditional material management approach couldn't keep pace with the speed and complexity of global operations.
room: Level 2, Hall B, Expo, Industry Theater
speakers: Andrea Corneo (Lead Data & AI Scientist, Eni S.p.A.)
Paolo Romagnoli (Sr. Solution Architect, AWS)

title: How Jack in the Box delivers personalized store reporting at scale
abstract: Franchise operators run restaurants, not BI tools. In this session, learn how Jack in the Box delivered store-specific performance reports and actionable insights straight to every operator's inbox across 2,100+ locations. We'll cover throttle-aware parallel orchestration, failure isolation patterns, and how this approach turns business intelligence into a scalable, zero-friction communication channel that drives operator engagement and revenue. Walk away with a reusable blueprint for high-volume, per-location reporting in any multi-unit retail or restaurant business
room: Level 2, Hall B, Expo, Industry Theater

title: DTCC: Rethinking mainframe modernization with spec-driven development
abstract: Services like Kiro, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, AWS Continuum, and AWS DevOps Agent have enabled DTCC to rethink its software delivery lifecycle. Now, the company is harnessing agents to modernize its legacy mainframe infrastructure. DTCC has adopted a spec-driven approach to COBOL refactoring, front-loading the process with a focus on principles, target architecture, and anti-pattern avoidance. In this session, you’ll see how a small team of engineers produced a fully functional microservice-based trade data ingestion platform in a few weeks, cutting the development timeline by 60% while laying the foundation to scale to peaks of 300+ million trades per day and beyond.
room: Upper Convention Promenade, Cristal 2, Content Hub, Red Theater
speakers: Elie El khoury (Senior Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)
Baps Patil (Director, DTCC)

title: How Hyundai Is Transforming Customer and Vehicle Experiences on AWS
abstract: Hyundai Motor Group is redefining mobility, and AWS is helping pave the way. Discover how Hyundai is using AWS to help deliver Software-Defined Vehicles (SDVs) that evolve through continuous updates, an in-vehicle AI agent that lets drivers manage vehicle functions through natural voice, and an app marketplace that allows drivers to customize their driving experience. Hear how Hyundai is using AI agents to better understand the needs of their customers, deploying Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to monitor, study, and address customer feedback across 17 languages. Walk away with real-world lessons on bringing agentic AI and connected vehicle platforms to production scale.
room: Upper Convention Promenade, Cristal 2, Content Hub, Purple Theater
speakers: Yunsang Hwang (Sr. Solutions Architect, AWS)
Eundoo Song (Team Lead, 42dot)
Eunjee Moon (Senior Project Manager, Hyundai Motor Company)

title: The Trade Desk's Cloud Journey: AI-Assisted Optimization to AI Agents
abstract: The Trade Desk operates a real-time advertising platform on AWS, where infrastructure must handle massive scale while making bidding decisions in milliseconds. At that volume, cloud cost optimization is a continuous discipline, not a one-time audit. In this breakout, The Trade Desk shares how it moved from manual cost audits to an AI-assisted approach: an internal MCP server that lets AI agents investigate cost and usage data, surface savings across services like S3, NAT Gateway, EBS, and Graviton, and apply a repeatable method for optimizing workloads over time. You'll see how the team structured the agents, what they found, and where the approach is headed.
room: Level 1, Forum 120, Content Hub, Blue Theater
speakers: Shreyas Shah (Staff Product Manager, The TradeDesk)
Sharik Pahwa (Principal Technical Account Manager, Amazon Web Services)

title: Accelerate Physical AI development with NVIDIA on AWS
abstract: Physical AI is reshaping manufacturing, robotics, and autonomous systems, but realizing that potential requires robust infrastructure and purpose-built tools. AWS and NVIDIA have partnered to simplify the entire Physical AI development lifecycle: from synthetic data generation and model training through sim-to-real validation and hardware-in-loop testing. In this session, discover how the Physical AI Toolchain from AWS provides access to AWS managed infrastructure and NVIDIA’s foundation models and training applications to accelerate every stage of development, reduce time-to-market, and optimize resource utilization across your pipeline.
speakers: Shaun Kirby (Principal ProServe Cloud Architect, AWS)
Abhishek Srivastav (Principal Solutions Architect, AWS)

title: Agentic advertising with privacy-enhanced data collaboration
abstract: Programmatic advertising is shifting from rule-based heuristics to autonomous agents that plan, orchestrate, and bid inside the millisecond bidstream. This Lightning Talk shows three AWS building blocks combining into one agentic ad tech stack: multi-agent collaboration on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore for media planning and inventory optimization; ARTF-compliant containers running deep-learning models on NVIDIA Triton and Amazon EKS for real-time bid shading, audience activation, and deal management; and AWS Clean Rooms ML as the trust layer, training lookalike models on collective data without exposing underlying records. Leave with a reference architecture for where inference, orchestration, and privacy all work together.
room: Level 2, Hall B, Expo, Industry Theater
speakers: Ryan Malecky (Pr. Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)
Zelle Steyn (Principal Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)

title: Compete to build an AI agent with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
abstract: Organizations are ready to move beyond rule-based workflows to agents that reason, adapt, and act. In this gamified workshop, you'll use Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to assemble a realistic conversational banking agent end-to-end: orchestration with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness; secure tool integration with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway; and guardrails with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Policy. Prebuilt modules accelerate development so you can focus on agent logic. Compete in real time as your agent's accuracy and efficiency are scored on a live leaderboard. Leave with a working agent pattern you can adapt to your own use cases and bragging rights on the leaderboard.

Laurent Guizard (Principal Solutions Architect, AWS)

title: AI-driven customer experience with Amaze, Byte by Yum! & Amorepacific
abstract: Customer experience in retail and consumer goods used to depend on how much staff you could put on the floor, the screen, or the line. Agentic AI changes the math: agents guide shoppers, support team members, and adapt to what a customer needs in real time. Hear how three brands put agents to work. Amaze, CP Group's super app, built an AI shopping assistant for shoppers across the group's brands, including 7-Eleven Thailand; Byte by Yum! powers personalized ordering and team member tools at Taco Bell; and Amorepacific built an AI beauty concierge delivering precision skin diagnoses across 10 countries.
room: Level 1, Forum 120, Content Hub, Red Theater
speakers: Joey Ahnn (Chief Digital Officer, AMOREPACIFIC)
Jeremiah Sheehy (CTO, Yum! Brands)
Chatnapang Wuthiwatana (Chief of Data Insight and AI, Ascend Commerce - Amaze)

title: LSEG: Scaling multi-agent AI with assurance on Amazon Bedrock
abstract: London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) manages one of the world's largest risk intelligence datasets, processing millions of records that demand continuous curation and validation. In this session, learn how LSEG built a durable agentic AI framework on Amazon Bedrock—orchestrating multi-agent workflows that combines deterministic rules, AI enrichment, and human review to reduce false positives in financial crime screening. LSEG will share their approach to continuous AI assurance with golden dataset evaluations and staged rollout gates with real-time observability and automated rollback to safely scale automation while maintaining the accuracy global financial institutions require.
room: Upper Convention Promenade, Cristal 2, Content Hub, Purple Theater
speakers: Zan Kavtaskin (Director of Architecture, Risk Intelligence, LSEG)
Richard Chester (Principal Solution Architect, AWS)
Christopher Hughes (Head of Screening Engineering, LSEG)

title: How Stripe built an enterprise agent platform on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
abstract: Operating global payments infrastructure requires AI that is secure, reliable, and scalable across internal and customer-facing experiences. Learn how Stripe built a shared agent platform for Kai, its company-wide AI coworker, and hundreds of other AI workflows. Stripe will share how it integrated Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Code Interpreter with its existing infrastructure, data-access controls, and security model. Discover the architectural decisions that helped Stripe move rapidly from prototype to company-wide adoption, supporting more than 10,000 employees and nearly 500,000 Kai sessions each week.
room: Upper Convention Promenade, Cristal 2, Content Hub, White Theater
speakers: Hasan Tariq (Principal Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)
Anupam Upadhyay (Software Engineer, Stripe)
Sharadh Krishnamurthy (Engineering Manager, Stripe)

title: NatWest: Embedding AI agents into the software delivery lifecycle
abstract: AI is moving beyond code completion to reshape how software is built. In this session, learn how NatWest, one of the UK's largest banks, uses Kiro and agentic AI to accelerate design, development, and delivery across its engineering organization. NatWest will share how it embeds AI into everyday engineering while meeting the demands of a highly regulated environment, from security and compliance guardrails to identity and access integration and governance. Explore how the team measures developer productivity and reinvents its delivery workflows. You’ll learn how to bring agentic development to your own engineering teams.
room: Upper Convention Promenade, Cristal 2, Content Hub, Blue Theater
speakers: Rafael Mosca (Solutions Architect, AWS)
Diana Kennedy (Chief Information Officer, Retail and Enterprise Architecture, NatWest Group)
Raj Dasoar (Distinguished Engineer, NatWest)

title: Aon: Turning raw exposure data into faster underwriting
abstract: Insurers and brokers process thousands of Statements of Values annually, complex unstructured documents that require manual extraction and validation and delay quoting and bind decisions. In this lightning talk, learn how Aon built an AI-powered exposure data ingestion platform on Amazon Bedrock using Anthropic Claude, AWS Lambda, and Amazon S3. See how the platform transforms unstructured data into standardized, risk-ready information with improved address quality, geocoding precision, and hazard identification, reducing document processing from days to minutes and feeding higher-quality inputs to catastrophe models.
room: Level 2, Hall B, Expo, Industry Theater
speakers: Hasan Mehdi Rizvi (Sr. Solution Architect, AWS)
Sudipto Dasgupta (Global Head of Enterprise Architecture & Data and AI Platforms, Aon)

title: Robinhood: Scaling in-app agentic trading to every investor on AWS
abstract: Hedge funds rely on research, strategy tools, and around-the-clock execution. Retail investors rarely have access to the institutional-grade research and real-time analysis that professionals depend on. In this session, discover how Robinhood built Robinhood Agents, an in-app agentic trading experience built on Amazon Bedrock. Customers can build their own agent to research the market, develop strategies, or trade within the limits they set. Learn how Robinhood's AI engineering leaders built an internal agentic platform focused on trust, security, and safety and how that later evolved and scaled to power Robinhood Agents. Hear about the architecture, guardrails, and lessons learned delivering institutional intelligence at consumer scale.
room: Upper Convention Promenade, Cristal 2, Content Hub, Purple Theater
speakers: Chirantan Mahipal (Software Engineer, Robinhood)
Sreeram Ramji (Director, Robinhood Markets, Inc.)

title: Data mesh to agentic AI: Building an AI-ready enterprise on AWS
abstract: How do you build an AI-ready data foundation in a global investment organization without compromising trust, governance, or speed? CPP Investments—manager of one of the world’s largest pension funds—is evolving from fragmented data toward a governed enterprise data platform on AWS, using data mesh principles, federated ownership, and platform engineering to scale with guardrails. Join their CTO for a look inside the architecture, operating model, and critical trade-offs shaping this evolution, and how it brings trusted data closer to investment decisions while laying the foundation for conversational data experiences and agentic AI.
room: Upper Convention Promenade, Cristal 2, Content Hub, Blue Theater
speakers: Prasanna Ramaswamy (Head Of Technology & Data, Canadian Pension Plan Investment Board)
Rishi Gera (Solutions Architect, AWS)

title: A Context Gap, Not a Data Gap: Riot Games Rethinks Incident Learning
abstract: Live-service teams excel at detecting incidents and restoring service, but using each review to improve the next response remains difficult. Riot Games has extensive telemetry, incident records, triage practices, and root cause analysis, yet analysts must still connect evidence across systems. Riot Games and AWS share an AI-assisted post-incident review approach that brings evidence together, provides traceable recommendations, and keeps decisions with human reviewers. Explore how preserving uncertainty, linking claims to source evidence, and using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore as a reusable foundation can help teams close context gaps and improve operational learning.
room: Level 1, Forum 120, Content Hub, White Theater
speakers: Randy James (Principal Forward Deployed Engineer - AWS Enterprise Support, AWS)
Cory Ramirez (Manager, Technical Product Management, Riot Games)

title: From Generic to Industry Expert: The Next Era of AI
abstract: AI assistants handle calendars and inboxes but fall short on domain-specific workflows. What if AI could understand your industry's systems, standards, and compliance requirements? In this session, we explore how pre-configured agents, skills, knowledge bases, and ISV connectors can address industry-specific use cases while giving customers the flexibility to extend and customize their enterprise workflows. Learn how AI assistants can go beyond a general-purpose productivity tool into a domain expert for your industry.

title: Visa: Building autonomous defense for payments security in the agentic AI era
abstract: Visa secures one of the world's largest payment ecosystems, processing over $14 trillion across 300+ billion transactions annually. As AI-powered threats evolve, Visa is reimagining cybersecurity through hybrid-cloud architecture with 70+ controls framework, AI-driven operations, and an agentic control plane designed for autonomous defense. Built on an Agentic harness with Zero-Trust principles and AWS capabilities, such as Amazon GuardDuty and AWS Nitro Enclaves, and cloud-agnostic security controls, Visa continuously detects and mitigates risk across its cloud environment. Discover how Visa is building a security foundation for the agentic AI era, protecting today's payments ecosystem while enabling AI-powered applications and autonomous workloads.
room: Upper Convention Promenade, Cristal 2, Content Hub, White Theater
speakers: Gaurav Priyolkar (Principal Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)
Vaijayanti Korde (Head of Cybersecurity Cloud & Crypto Platform, Visa Inc)

title: AT&T Expands Connectivity with AWS Interconnect and Amazon Leo
abstract: As a telecom operator, your customers demand resilient, scalable last mile connectivity for their AI workloads. This session shows new options for delivering that. You'll learn how to integrate AWS Interconnect - last mile with your control plane, provisioning connections directly from the AWS Management Console. AT&T shares how they're deploying Interconnect last-mile to expand their connectivity portfolio. They'll also share how they're working with Amazon Leo to bring broadband satellite connectivity to areas with limited connectivity. Leave with a clear model for extending your own connectivity offerings.

speakers: Anudeep Athlur (Senior Product Manager - Technical, Amazon)
Jad Naim (Sr. Solution Architect - Telco, Amazon Web Services)
Gordon Shannon (Partner Ecosystem GTM, AT&T)

title: How a state agency transformed constituent services with Connect Customer
abstract: When the Georgia Department of Community Supervision needed to modernize their contact center, they turned to Amazon Connect Customer and AI. In this session, hear firsthand how AI-powered call analysis, real-time transcription, and automated case notes are changing the way officers and staff handle daily interaction. We share lessons learned from discovery through implementation, including how to prioritize high-impact AI use cases and build stakeholder buy-in across a state agency. You’ll leave with actionable strategies to bring AI-powered constituent services to your own agency.
room: Upper Convention Promenade, Cristal 2, Content Hub, Blue Theater

Jarbas Carvalho (Deputy CIO, GA-State of Georgia | Department of Community Supervision)

title: TP ICAP: Driving revenue through faster decisions with agentic AI
abstract: Trading opportunities slip away when teams can't synthesize fragmented data fast enough to act. In this session, global broker TP ICAP will share how it built First Mate on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, an AI sales-trading tool that uses generative AI to identify and act on opportunities in global markets more effectively. Discover how First Mate ingests real-time data, applies domain reasoning, and delivers actionable recommendations to brokers in seconds. We’ll discuss the architectural decisions and outcomes behind the journey from prototype to production. You’ll learn how to bring agentic AI to time-sensitive operations where speed-to-insight can drive revenue.
speakers: Erica Martin (Senior AI Engineer, TP ICAP)
Animesh Kundu (Sr. Customer Solutions Manager, AWS)
Shahen Bokhari (AI Product Portfolio Lead, TP ICAP)

title: Lives on the Line: Modernizing National Weather Forecasting on AWS
abstract: The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration's National Weather Service (NWS) is modernizing the platform forecasters rely on across 170+ locations. Join AWS and NOAA to whiteboard the NWS Enterprise Cloud (NEC), the foundation providing secure, scalable landing zones where HIVE applications and CIRRUS data services operate. We'll explore decomposing a legacy desktop into micro-frontends and domain microservices on Amazon EKS, decoupling applications from data through an API abstraction layer, scaling independently during severe weather, and maintaining continuous Authority to Operate (ATO). We'll also discuss how Amazon SageMaker brings machine learning assistance to forecasters. Bring your modernization questions.
speakers: David Santore (Solutions Architect, AWS)
Rayette Toles-Abdullah (Principal Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)

title: Building Worlds for Machines: VAMS and 3DGS for Autonomy
abstract: Autonomous platforms are only as capable as the environments they train and validate in. In this Lightning Talk, see how AWS uses the Visual Asset Management System (VAMS) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) to turn real field data collected during Project MAVERICK exercises into high-fidelity, simulation-ready environments. We walk the pipeline from sensor capture to reconstructed, simulation-ready worlds, and the content management that makes them reusable. These environments are not the autonomy; they are what builds, improves, and validates it. If you build or validate autonomous systems, you leave knowing how to turn field capture into reusable simulation-ready environments.
room: Upper Convention Promenade, Cristal 2, Content Hub, Lightning Theater

title: How Chamberlain and Daikin power smart product innovation with AWS
abstract: Manufacturers are transforming products into connected, intelligent offerings that deliver proactive, personalized customer experiences. Discover how AWS helps you build, connect, and monetize smart products at global scale. Hear how Chamberlain Group migrated its myQ smart home product platform, with 15M+ devices and 12M+ users, to AWS—eliminating multi-cloud complexity and furthering their AI and video intelligence offerings. Also learn how Daikin is using AWS to deliver 24/7 remote monitoring and predictive control across an extensive network of HVAC systems. Walk away with proven patterns for scaling connected products and unlocking AI-driven service revenue.

title: Human+AI Collaboration: How Amazon Deploys Autonomous Operations on AWS
abstract: Amazon deploys humanoids, autonomous mobile robots, and humans as a unified workforce operating side-by-side on the fulfillment floor. Learn how Amazon evolved an AI-powered verification pipeline, built with Amazon Nova on Bedrock to validate 200K+ items, into a fleet orchestration platform dispatching foundation-model inference across humanoids, quadrupeds, AMRs, and drones. We deep-dive into the architectural patterns enabling humans to work alongside robots at scale: a serverless Lambda backend that abstracts the robot form factor, multi-vendor humanoid integration, and edge deployment strategies. You'll leave with a framework for physical AI orchestration of heterogeneous fleets while optimizing throughput and cost.

abstract: City governments face rising citizen expectations with shrinking staff. In this builders' session, learn how to deploy a fully functional AI-powered community engagement portal using Amazon Connect Customer agentic voice in under one hour. See how to build a voice agent that answers common citizen inquiries about permits, utilities, parks, and city services, routes callers to the right department, and seamlessly escalates to live agents with full conversation context when needed. Walk away with a production-ready reference architecture that operations team can configure, deploy, and manage independently.

title: Build a governed semantic layer with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and MCP
abstract: Financial services organizations struggle with inconsistent metric definitions, AI hallucination risks, and analyst bottlenecks. In this session, you’ll build a governed semantic layer with three key pillars (accuracy, consistency, and explainability) essential for agents to operate securely at scale. You’ll then connect to AI agents powered by Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that query, interpret, and act on financial data via MCP, enabling natural language access to complex financial metrics. Your agents reason rather than guess, with full auditability for financial regulators. Leave with a production-ready architecture pattern that goes beyond "chat with your data" demos.

title: Accelerate service onboarding with composable AI plugins
abstract: Service onboarding workflows consume hours across security, risk, and governance teams through manual approvals, evidence gathering, and threat modeling. These tasks are auditable, repetitive, and ripe for agentic decomposition. In this chalk talk, we walk through a composable AI plugin pattern that decomposes service onboarding into lightweight modules any agentic client can consume. We discuss how each plugin integrates with any agentic client to execute governance checks end-to-end. We share architecture patterns, working code examples, and show you how to reduce security review time. You’ll leave with a decomposition pattern and an open-source repo to get started.

Aditi Pendharkar (Principal, FSI Security & GRC, AWS)

title: Build an Agentic AI Marketing Engine Powered by Amazon Bedrock
abstract: In this hands-on builder session, construct a multi-agent AI system that automates campaign planning, activation, and optimization. Build four specialized agents on Amazon Bedrock including a planner, media buyer, analyst, and creative generator that turns campaign parameters into audience targeting, budget allocation, performance forecasts, and localized creative grounded in your brand guidelines and historical data. Activate campaigns through Amazon Ads DSP, then add an optimizer agent with human-in-the-loop approvals that reallocates budget across channels as performance shifts. You'll build a running multi-agent workflow and take away the Bedrock agent definitions to adapt for your own campaigns.

title: Agents under oath: HIPAA-compliant agentic AI on AWS
abstract: AI agents in government healthcare don't just query databases. They reason, remember, and act. Each of those capabilities opens a new surface where protected health information (PHI) can leak model responses, persistent memory, tool calls, RAG retrieval, and agent traces. Traditional RBAC and encryption were not built for this. In this chalk talk, we will walk through a real prior authorization determination scenario together, map where PHI bleeds through an ungoverned agent and then redesign the architecture as a group — four trust zones, sixteen controls, all mapped to HIPAA Security Rule safeguards. Come ready to draw and debate.
speakers: Vignesh Srinivasan (Sr Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)
Ray Chang (Principal Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)

title: Implement AI agent safety controls with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
abstract: Scaling AI agents into production without safety controls creates compliance, cost, and operational risk for financial services organizations. In this workshop, build an agent safety control system using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Starting with a deployed agent, configure three signal pipelines: observability via Amazon AgentCore Observability and Amazon CloudWatch; cost monitoring with AWS Budgets; and Amazon AgentCore Runtime Evaluation for behavioral deviation detection. Then build an admin control panel that aggregates alerts and enables human-in-the-loop interventions including session termination and fine-grained authorization via Cedar policies. Leave with a proven approach you can replicate to deliver responsible, governed AI agents at scale.
speakers: Prasanth Ponnoth (Principal Solutions Architect, AWS)
Milan Bavadiya (Associate Solutions Architect, AWS)

title: Healthcare & Life Sciences AI Agents: From Spec to Demo in 120 Min
abstract: Healthcare and life sciences teams face pressure to apply generative AI, but they struggle to move from proof-of-concept to prototype. In this hands-on workshop, you’ll use Kiro IDE and spec-driven development to build a functional AI agent, progressing through requirements, design, implementation, and live demo. Choose from four use cases: extract data from handwritten GMP batch records, orchestrate single-cell RNA-seq pipelines on AWS HealthOmics, identify clinical trial candidates using biomarker analysis, or build a patient access agent on Amazon Connect Health. You'll create a deployable agent, reusable specs, and a repeatable methodology for rapid AI development in regulated environments.

title: From static to self-improving agents with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
abstract: AI agents that learn from every production cycle deliver better outcomes without retraining or manual prompt tuning. In this chalk talk, we'll explore how Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations scores live agent behavior across multiple quality dimensions and how the optimization capability discovers better system prompts and tool configurations from production traces. Learn how the agent improves continuously from production results, expert corrections, and revised context your team contributes. We'll demonstrate the full observe-evaluate-improve cycle with an underwriting agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and the Strands Agents Framework, then discuss how the pattern applies to claims, fraud, and customer service agents.
speakers: Sid Singh (Principal SA, AWS)
Philipp Klose (Solution Architect, Amazon Web Services)

title: Securing AI agents: Governance patterns for regulated workloads
abstract: Financial institutions building agentic AI platforms face a fundamental problem: security and governance controls were designed for humans and applications, not autonomous agents. In this chalk talk, we'll whiteboard the architecture decisions that matter most—covering identity, authorization, secrets, tenancy, and governance—and classify each as a one-way or two-way door. We'll walk through concrete patterns including agent authentication, agent-to-tool authorization, application-layer data segregation, and a multi-source governance model using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Amazon CloudWatch, and AWS CloudTrail. Leave with decisions you can apply to your own agentic platform.
speakers: Manjit Chakraborty (Senior Solution Architect, Amazon Web Services)

title: In-Country HPC: How TGS Processes Seismic Data on AWS Brazil
abstract: TGS -- one of the world's largest multi-client geoscience data providers -- faced a significant cost challenge running its business-critical Rackmon EFWI GPU workload at scale. By strategically deploying this workload on AWS infrastructure in Brazil, TGS leveraged Brazil's ReData Special Tax Regime to dramatically reduce the tax burden on GPU-intensive seismic processing. The result: material cost savings on one of the most computationally demanding workloads in the energy industry -- and a reusable in-country processing architecture that can serve future customers with data residency requirements in other geographies.
speakers: Kun Jiao (Principal Solutions Architect, AWS)
Faisal Asif (Global Head, Cloud Transformation and Innovation, TGS)

abstract: Strict national security mandates block government agencies from adopting cloud GenAI. To resolve this, architects deploy a decoupled edge-to-cloud tokenization pattern. You will deploy local data tokenization, route masked payloads to Amazon Bedrock for stateless inference, and reconcile state on-premises. abstract: AI agents are reshaping how consumers discover and purchase products, and retail and CPG brands have a massive opportunity to meet them where they are. This chalk talk covers both sides of the agentic commerce stack. First, we walk through how retailers can launch conversational shopping customized to their catalog and brand voice in weeks with the Agentic Shopping Assistant on AWS, powered by Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and inspired by Amazon's own AI shopping experience. Then we explore how to make your platform discoverable by external AI agents through structured product feeds, headless APIs, and payment orchestration for machine-initiated transactions.

title: Defeat Player Evasion: AI Moderation at Scale on Amazon Bedrock.
abstract: Players evade moderation with leetspeak, homoglyphs, emoji sequences, and fast-evolving slang. Brute-force AI classification catches evasion but is cost-prohibitive at scale. In this workshop, build a tiered moderation pipeline on Amazon Bedrock that routes 80–90% of traffic through deterministic normalization and pre-filters before invoking a model. Ambiguous content gets classified by Amazon Nova at sub-500ms latency. Only the hardest cases escalate to multi-agent analysis on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore for context-dependent decisions. Configure per-category thresholds, instrument cost-per-decision tracking, and stress-test against real gaming evasion patterns. Walk away with a deployable, cost-optimized pipeline. Laptop required
speakers: Anand Iyer (Principal Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)
Christina Defoor (Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)

title: Build agentic fraud detection with a transaction foundation model
abstract: Organized fraud rings exploit the gaps between siloed detection systems, making them invisible to traditional rules-based approaches. In this workshop, you’ll construct a fraud detection optimization system that tackles them at scale. Load 24M transactions into Apache Iceberg, build a knowledge graph with Amazon Neptune to reveal hidden fraud networks, and train an ensemble combining transaction foundation model embeddings with graph embeddings for measurable score improvement. Then deploy a multi-agent system on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that autonomously investigates patterns, expands fraud rings, and creates validated detection rules. Leave with an end-to-end working system you can replicate in your own environment.
speakers: Omer Dawelbeit (Principal FSI GTM SA, Amazon Web Services)
Sudhir Kalidindi (Principal Solutions Architect, AWS)

title: Zero-Shot Demand Forecasting with Chronos 2, SMUS, and Quick Suite
abstract: Stockouts and overstocks quietly erode margin for retail and CPG brands, driving lost sales, markdowns, and working capital tied up in the wrong inventory. Traditional forecasting models take months to train and tune, and struggle with the cold-start problem for new products and locations. In this chalk talk, we whiteboard how to architect zero-shot demand forecasting pipelines using Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio with the Chronos 2 time-series foundation model, developed by the Amazon Science team and proven on Amazon's own retail and CPG demand at scale, requiring no historical model training. We walk through the end-to-end design: SMUS notebooks for rapid experimentation, Chronos 2 for multi-variate time series prediction, and Amazon Quick Suite for conversational analytics that let planners explore forecasts in natural language..
speakers: saadari Adari (Principal Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)
Prakash Srinivasan (Senior Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)

title: Building the semantic intelligence layer for enterprise AI agents
abstract: Every AI agent in the enterprise reasons better when it shares a common semantic understanding of the business. In this chalk talk, we show you how to build an Agentic Intelligence Layer that resolves meaning across every system and makes it innately consumable by any agent. We break down how to combine semantic embeddings, knowledge graph relationships, and natural-language memories into a single, governed layer that every agent reads from and writes back to. We take product and customer intelligence as the first domains and show how the same architecture extends to supply chain, operations, finance, and workforce. The result is a semantic intelligence layer that compounds learning across the business and transforms everything from demand forecasting to conversational commerce to enterprise decision-making.
speakers: Jordi Macià Ferrer (Sr. Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)
David Christian (Principal Solutions Architect, AWS)

title: Transform Episodic Content into High-Converting Microdramas
abstract: Turn your episodic content into binge-worthy microdramas. In this session, you'll learn how to build both single- and multi-episode formats, multiply one source into a library of platform-ready content assets, and monetize a story in multiple ways including advertising, subscription, and social distribution. We'll walk through scroll-stopping production techniques optimized for vertical, mobile-first viewing, and the pacing and cliffhanger patterns that drive completion and re-watch rates. Leave with a repeatable workflow for producing microdrama series at scale and a clear playbook for turning your existing catalog into high-converting, platform-ready short-form videos.
speakers: Saurav Bhattacharya (Senior Solutions Architect, AWS)
Chris Swan (Principal Solutions Architect, AWS)

title: Innovate faster, stay compliant: Innovation Sandbox for financial services
abstract: Financial services organizations need to experiment fast while meeting regulatory and governance requirements. In this chalk talk, explore how organizations deploy Innovation Sandbox on AWS to give teams safe, ephemeral environments without compromising security posture. We’ll discuss real-world patterns for network isolation, automated guardrails via SCPs, and time-bound account lifecycles that satisfy risk committees and regulators. We’ll walk through how organizations balance developer autonomy with controls mapped to frameworks like SR 26-2 and OCC heightened standards, and you’ll leave with practical approaches for rolling out Innovation Sandbox on AWS while keeping compliance teams confident.
speakers: Gonzalo Escarrá (Sr. Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)
Peter DeVries (Sr. Product Manager, AWS)

title: Production Agentic Trading: Build the pipeline Moeve runs on AgentCore
abstract: This session details the implementation of an agentic workforce managing the trade lifecycle in production energy trading operations. In this workshop, you'll build the pipeline Moeve runs in production: a Strands agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that extracts deal data from unstructured emails, resolves ambiguity deterministically against master data, and carries evidence per field. You'll harden it with Amazon Bedrock Guardrails on input and output, then score it for accuracy and run-to-run consistency, including the fields that measured badly, and why. You'll leave with a reusable pattern for production deployment of mission-critical trading workflows with strict latency and reliability requirements.
speakers: Aristides Fernandez (Sr. Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)
Loreto Albinana (Head of Generative AI, Moeve)

title: Duke Energy: Human-Led, Agent-Driven Enterprise App Innovation on AWS
abstract: Duke Energy is pioneering a new frontier in software creation by combining human leadership with agent-driven execution using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and AppGen, its enterprise AI platform. Specialized agents enable both developers and business users to rapidly build production-ready, full-stack applications with speed and precision, driving millions in cost savings while accelerating innovation. This strategic, multi-year collaboration is transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated processes across business units. The approach supports scalable adoption of agentic AI while ensuring strong governance, reliability, and operational excellence—empowering teams to innovate faster, reduce complexity, and modernize systems consistently across the enterprise.
room: Upper Convention Promenade, Cristal 2, Content Hub, Red Theater
speakers: Mrunal Daftari (Sr Solutions Architect, AWS)
Archy Peesapati (Sr. IT Manager, Duke Energy Corporation)
Daniel D Morris (Senior IT Manager, Duke Energy)

title: Modernize a Legacy Telecom Billing App with AWS Transform Custom
abstract: Got an old telecom application buried under decades of technical debt? In this hands-on session, you'll take a legacy BSS billing system and modernize it using AWS Transform Custom. Start by analyzing the codebase to understand business logic, dependencies, and technical debt. Then apply a built-in catalog transformation to upgrade the language and framework instantly. Next, define your own custom transformation in natural language to convert legacy interfaces to modern APIs. Validate, test for functional equivalence, and deploy to AWS. Walk away with a running modernized app and reusable transformation recipes, plus hands-on experience modernizing real-world telecom applications.
room: Level 1, Forum 120, Content Hub, Builders' Session 2
speakers: Rabindra Shakya (Global Solution Architect, Amazon)
Albeda Siddique (Senior Solutions Architect, Amazon (AWS))
Guy Ben-Baruch (Principal Solution Architect, AWS)

title: Build a Research Co-Scientist Using Amazon Quick
abstract: Learn how to build your own co-scientist with Amazon Quick. In this builder session, you'll gain hands-on experience with loading life sciences domain skills directly into Amazon Quick, and work through your own scientific questions with guidance from AWS's life sciences experts. Learn how to bring expert-level reasoning to everyday research workflows.
speakers: Lisa McFerrin (WW Lead Strategy & Solution - Research, AWS)
Ariella Sasson (Worldwide Specialist Solution Architect HCLS – Data & AI/ML, AWS)
Sujaya Srinivasan (Principal research and genomics specialist, Amazon web services)
Atul Chaudhari (Healthcare and Life Sciences Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)

title: Don't ban it, broker it: Govern AI coding agents with Amazon Bedrock
abstract: AI coding agents are becoming embedded in development workflows. In regulated environments (e.g.,financial services), that raises concerns around data residency, code exfiltration, auditability, and runaway costs. But banning the tools creates shadow AI. In this session, we'll whiteboard a better path by pointing AI coding agents at Amazon Bedrock through a gateway in your VPC. One control point for identity, data residency, prompt inspection, Amazon Bedrock Guardrails, cost controls, and immutable audit. We'll walk through the request lifecycle, debate trade-offs around latency, budgets, and MCP tool calls, and show how the same broker pattern governs any agent touching sensitive data.
speakers: Karthik Mokashi (Sr. Solutions Architect, AWS)
Jayanth Ranjan (Senior Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services)

title: Emerging multi-agent patterns for complex financial workflows
abstract: Multi-agent systems are rapidly evolving beyond static orchestration patterns. In this chalk talk, we explore the newest collaboration paradigms gaining momentum, including ephemeral agent patterns and self-improving agents, alongside established approaches like hierarchical, sequential, and peer-to-peer coordination. Walk through how to apply these patterns to claims adjudication, underwriting, and financial portfolio advisory using Strands Agents and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness engineering best practices. We'll discuss when to select each pattern, how to combine them for complex workflows, and how AgentCore harness capabilities enable scalable, governed multi-agent architectures. Gain practical guidance for designing the next generation of agentic applications.
speakers: Evandro Franco (Senior GenAI Data Scientist, AWS)
Alfredo Castillo (Sr WW Specialist SA - GenAI, AWS)

title: How to Deploy Purpose-Built Clinical AI Agents to Production with Speed and Scale
abstract: Providers lose hours daily to documentation, manual coding, and admin work. Leading health IT builders are solving this with purpose-built AI on AWS. In this chalk talk, Innovaccer joins AWS to share how they trained task-specific clinical small language models that deliver consistent outputs where general-purpose LLMs produce unacceptable variance. We use their architecture as a jumping-off point to discuss the full spectrum of paths to production: custom model training on accelerated compute, multi-step agentic workflow orchestration, and embedding fully managed clinical AI capabilities into existing applications.
speakers: Deepti Chugh (Sr Solutions Architect, Amazon Web Services(AWS))
Ankit Maheshwari (Chief Technology & Product Officer, Innovaccer)

abstract: Natera, a global leader in cell-free DNA testing for oncology, women's health, and organ health, built reusable agentic infrastructure on Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to power multiple internal platforms from a single framework. Natera's VP of Engineering will share the technical decisions behind this infrastructure and provides a blueprint for building once and scaling across your organization. See a live demo of one platform built on this foundation for revenue cycle management, cutting prior-authorization denial rates 6x, reducing touchpoints by 5x, and enabling new use cases to go live in less than a week.

Mirko Buholzer (VP Software Engineering, Natera, Inc.)
